Growing up, my mom always bought one really special roll of wrapping paper each Christmas. It was thicker, more colorful, and a little more of a splurge than our usual wrapping paper. Every present from Santa was wrapped in it.

I couldn’t tell you what most of those presents were, but I remember the “Santa” paper. Not what it looked like, but how special it made everything feel.

And that’s exactly what I want my wrapping paper to be for you.

The paper you save for the special gifts. The ones you wrap with a little extra love. The ones you hope someone remembers years from now.

I only have a limited amount made each year, and this year’s designs are here! I’ll be bringing some along to my holiday events, too, so be sure to snag some now before it runs out.

I’ve never been at a loss for words. This weekend came close.

I said yes to glamping and Mahjong at Nine Pines, and I came home with my faith in humanity restored.

The two incredible women behind tilesandntonic brought us together to support ordinary_hero, which helps children and families in Ethiopia. They had no agenda. They just had an idea, a whole lot of heart, and the kind of goodness that pulls everyone in with it.

Yes, we played Mahjong. We also hiked, played pickleball, went to the spa, ate far too well, and stayed toasty in our hottommies vests. Then, in our last gratitude session, we all ended up in tears.

The world can feel cutthroat and heartless, but there are so many people quietly doing good and wanting the best for one another. For one life-changing weekend, I got to be surrounded by them.

To every woman who sat across from me: thank you. I’ll be carrying this one with me for a long time.

To learn more about Ordinary Hero and the families they serve, visit ordinaryhero.org.
